Personality: Tasgetios, a prominent figure of the Carnutes, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Tasgetios owes allegiance to the Belgic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Carnutes. Historical Record: Of an ancient line of Carnute kings, in whose land the druids of Gaul meet each year. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
